blocks.translation: Clear Date

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Substance / Story

blocks.source: 自分の場合、難易度はノーマルでクリアまで３２時間ほど。
blocks.translation: In my case, it took about 32 hours to clear the game on Normal difficulty.

blocks.source: それなりにサブクエストをやったり、道に迷ったり、ボス戦に苦戦したり、イベントで手間取ったりした上でのクリア時間。シリーズの過去作品と比較しても、メインストーリーは短いように思う。
blocks.translation: That clear time includes completing a fair number of side quests, getting lost, struggling with boss battles, and taking my time during events. Even compared with previous games in the series, the main story seems short.

blocks.source: ただサブクエストは豊富に存在するので、やりこめばもっとかかるはず。逆に難易度イージーでサクサク本編を進めれば、初回でも二十時間を切りそう。
blocks.translation: However, there are plenty of side quests, so it should take longer if you pursue them thoroughly. Conversely, if you breeze through the main story on Easy difficulty, it seems possible to finish it in under twenty hours even on a first playthrough.

blocks.source: 物語
blocks.translation: Story

blocks.source: 滅ぼされた王国の王子ノクティスが、三人の仲間と力を合わせ、帝国と戦うために立ち上がる。
blocks.translation: Noctis, prince of a kingdom that has been destroyed, rises up to fight the Empire alongside his three companions.

blocks.source: ノクティスは帝国と戦う力を手に入れるため、十三の武器を集め、六神（過去作の召喚獣に相当）の加護を得るために、旅をするのであった。
blocks.translation: Noctis travels to collect thirteen weapons and gain the blessings of the Six (equivalent to the summons in previous games) in order to obtain the power to fight the Empire.

blocks.source: ……と、これだけ書くとわりと王道なストーリー展開。ＦＦ１２にも設定がよく似ている。
blocks.translation: ...Put that way, it is a fairly standard story. Its setting also closely resembles Final Fantasy XII.

blocks.source: 特徴的なのは、ほとんどの場面で固定された男四人旅であること。女性キャラはスポット参戦のみ。
blocks.translation: What stands out is that, for most of the game, the party consists of the same four men. Female characters only join temporarily.

blocks.source: さらには自動車で旅をするというのも特徴的。ベタなファンタジー設定との組み合わせもあって、どことなくシュール。
blocks.translation: The fact that they travel by car is also distinctive. Combined with the conventional fantasy setting, it feels somewhat surreal.

blocks.source: ＦＦ１３と同じで、進行度によって物語の印象がガラリと変わる。
blocks.translation: As with Final Fantasy XIII, the impression of the story changes dramatically depending on your progress.

blocks.source: 前半は数人で帝国の基地に殴り込んだり、お使いイベントをこなしたり、十三の武器を探したりと、ゆるいノリで進んでいく。
blocks.translation: In the first half, the game progresses at a relaxed pace as you storm Imperial bases with a few companions, complete errands, and search for the thirteen weapons.

blocks.source: 始めて行く場所などでは、仲間達が色々と掛け合いをしてくれる。他愛ない内容も多いけれど、それがいっそう冒険感を高めてくれる。
blocks.translation: When you visit places for the first time, your companions exchange all kinds of banter. Much of it is trivial, but it makes the adventure feel even more genuine.

blocks.source: どちらかと言えば、サブクエスト重視のゲーム。メインストーリーそっちのけで、旅をするのが面白い。
blocks.translation: This is, if anything, a side quest-focused game. It is fun to travel around while neglecting the main story.

blocks.source: そこまでのオープンワールド的な雰囲気はよくできていて、ここまでは神ゲーっぽく見えなくもない。かくいう僕も「これから壮大なストーリー展開が！」と思っていました。
blocks.translation: The open-world atmosphere up to that point is well done, and until then, it is not hard to see the game as something exceptional. I myself thought, “An epic story is about to unfold!”

blocks.source: ……が、途中から一気に話が収束に向かっていく。ストーリーも急に一本道へ。
blocks.translation: ...But partway through, the story suddenly rushes toward its conclusion. It abruptly becomes completely linear as well.

blocks.source: これからヒロインが大活躍かと思ったら、そんなことはなかった。
blocks.translation: I thought the heroine would play a major role from that point on, but that did not happen.

blocks.source: 帝国の幹部と熾烈な戦いを繰り広げるのかと思ったら、そんなことはなかった。
blocks.translation: I thought we would have fierce battles with Imperial officials, but that did not happen.

blocks.source: 一時加入したサブキャラが、後半にまた活躍したりはしなかった。
blocks.translation: The supporting character who temporarily joined the party did not become active again in the latter half.

blocks.source: 十三の武器は別に集めなくてもよかった（サブイベントで回収可）。
blocks.translation: There was no particular need to collect the thirteen weapons (they can be recovered through side events).

blocks.source: じゃあ、何のために最初集めさせたの？
blocks.translation: Then why did the game make us collect them in the first place?

blocks.source: そもそも、本筋に深く関わる人物が全体で十人もいないような……。
blocks.translation: To begin with, there do not seem to be even ten characters in the entire game who are deeply involved in the main plot...

blocks.source: というように、ＦＦ１３を彷彿とさせるような尻すぼみ。
blocks.translation: As you can see, it peters out in a way reminiscent of Final Fantasy XIII.

blocks.source: しかも、後半はストーリー的にもゲーム的にもプレイヤーのメンタルにダメージを与える展開が続く。天下のＦＦでよくこんなのをやったなと、良くも悪くも感心してしまう。
blocks.translation: What is more, the latter half continues with developments that damage the player's mental state, both story-wise and gameplay-wise. I cannot help but admire, for better or worse, how they managed to do something like this in a major Final Fantasy title.

blocks.source: システム／バランス
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance

blocks.source: 戦闘
blocks.translation: Battle

blocks.source: 今作の特徴として、アクション型の戦闘が挙げられる。
blocks.translation: One of this game's defining features is its action-based battles.

blocks.source: ＦＦ１２のように見た目がアクションっぽいというだけではなく、れっきとしたアクション戦闘。
blocks.translation: Unlike Final Fantasy XII, where the battles merely looked somewhat like action games, these are genuine action battles.

blocks.source: ○ボタンを押しておけば自動的に近くの敵に攻撃してくれるので、そこは簡単。
blocks.translation: Simply hold down the ○ button and you will automatically attack a nearby enemy, so that part is easy.

blocks.source: 回避や防御もしっかりと効果がある。プレイスキルの差はそれなりに出るはず。
blocks.translation: Dodging and guarding are also properly effective. Differences in player skill should be noticeable to some extent.

blocks.source: 特徴的なのは、主人公ノクティスの特殊能力シフトブレイク。武器を投げた場所へ瞬時に移動することができる。遠方の敵へと一気に攻撃をしかけられるのは、なかなか気持ちがいい。
blocks.translation: The protagonist Noctis's distinctive special ability is Shift Break. It lets him instantly move to the location where he throws his weapon. Being able to launch an attack at a distant enemy all at once feels quite satisfying.

blocks.source: 今回の魔法は個数消費となった代わりに、威力も強力となった。強力な魔法を手にして、サブクエストの強敵に挑む自由度もある。
blocks.translation: In this game, magic is consumed by quantity instead, but its power has also been increased. You have the freedom to acquire powerful magic and challenge formidable enemies in side quests.

blocks.source: ただし、不満点もそれなりに。
blocks.translation: However, it has its fair share of frustrating points.

blocks.source: まず、アクション戦闘特有の『何をやってるのか分からない感』があること。
blocks.translation: First, there is the feeling, peculiar to action battles, of “not knowing what you are doing.”

blocks.source: 数が多い雑魚戦や、動きの派手なボス戦では、何をやっているのかわけが分からなくなりやすい。普通に戦っていると、いつの間にか攻撃を喰らってしまう。
blocks.translation: In battles against large numbers of weak enemies or bosses with flashy movements, it is easy to lose track of what is happening. If you fight normally, you may find yourself taking damage before you realize it.

blocks.source: 加えて、仲間の操作はＡＩ任せで指定できない。敵の大技を回避しようとせず、あっさり喰らってしまうのには弱った。
blocks.translation: In addition, you cannot control your companions or give them commands; they are left to the AI. It was frustrating to see them casually take powerful enemy attacks without even trying to evade them.

blocks.source: 結果、たどり着いたボス戦での戦法は、遠距離からチクチク攻撃。仲間がやられるのは諦めて、回復アイテム連打でゴリ押し。
blocks.translation: As a result, my strategy for boss battles became to chip away at them from a distance. I gave up on keeping my companions alive and brute-forced my way through by repeatedly using healing items.

blocks.source: なんせこのゲーム、回復アイテムの使用制限はかなりゆるい。金で集めた回復アイテムで粘り、ゴリ押しすればなかなか全滅しない。もちろんテンポは悪く、アクション性は台無し。
blocks.translation: After all, this game places very few restrictions on the use of healing items. If you hang on with healing items bought with money and brute-force your way through, it is surprisingly difficult to suffer a total party wipe. Of course, this ruins the pacing and completely undermines the action elements.

blocks.source: 古臭いコマンドバトルのＲＰＧにはありがちな調整だけど、何もそんなものまで持ち込まなくても……。と、結果的にコマンドバトルの悪いところと、アクションバトルの悪いところを合わせてしまったような印象を受けた。
blocks.translation: It is the kind of balancing commonly found in old-fashioned RPGs with command battles, but they really did not need to bring that into this game... Ultimately, it left me with the impression that it had combined the worst aspects of command battles with the worst aspects of action battles.

blocks.source: 難易度はノーマルでも結構高いので注意。敵の一撃がかなり重いので、適当に突っ込むとすぐにＨＰがなくなる。
blocks.translation: Be warned: the difficulty is quite high even on Normal. Enemy attacks hit extremely hard, so charging in carelessly will quickly deplete your HP.

blocks.source: アクションが苦手な人や、スムーズに進みたい人は、素直にイージーを選んだほうがいいかも。
blocks.translation: People who aren't good at action games, or who want to progress smoothly, might be better off simply choosing Easy.

blocks.source: というか、敵が強くなるほど回復アイテム連打によって作業的になってしまう。これなら、別にイージーでもよかったかなと……。
blocks.translation: In fact, the stronger the enemies become, the more the game turns into a chore of repeatedly using healing items. At this point, I probably should have chosen Easy...

blocks.source: 冒険
blocks.translation: Adventure

blocks.source: 戦闘は置いておくとして、このゲームの魅力はと聞かれれば、オープンワールド的な自由度だろう。
blocks.translation: Putting battles aside, if I had to name this game's appeal, it would be its open-world-like freedom.

blocks.source: 序盤から様々なサブクエストをこなしたり、メインストーリーには関係のないダンジョンがあったりと盛りだくさん。
blocks.translation: There's plenty to do, from completing various side quests early on to exploring dungeons unrelated to the main story.

blocks.source: 写真や釣りなどのおまけ要素も充実している。
blocks.translation: It also has plenty of bonus features, such as photography and fishing.

blocks.source: ただ上述した通り、後半は一本道になってしまう。
blocks.translation: However, as mentioned above, the latter half becomes completely linear.

blocks.source: ※一応、『神秘の力で過去に戻る』的なシステムで、オープンワールドのマップに戻ることは可能。
blocks.translation: ※Technically, a system akin to “returning to the past through mystical power” allows you to return to the open-world map.

blocks.source: そして、この一本道が何とも窮屈。
blocks.translation: And this linearity is extremely restrictive.

blocks.source: 特に問題となるのが十三章のダンジョン。『長い』『暗い』『不自由』の三重苦。
blocks.translation: The biggest problem is the dungeon in Chapter 13: a threefold ordeal of being “long,” “dark,” and “restrictive.”

blocks.source: 細い道を長々と進ませるような作りで、ストーリー的にも陰鬱。道中では数時間に渡って主人公一人で突き進まねばならない。しかも、途中までは能力制限がかかり使用できないアクションがある。
blocks.translation: It's designed to make you travel along narrow paths for a long time, and the story is gloomy as well. For several hours along the way, you have to press onward alone as the protagonist. On top of that, some actions are unavailable due to ability restrictions until partway through.

blocks.source: それまでのゲーム性を否定するような作りで、楽しいとは言えなかった。これ一つで自分の中での作品評価は一段階下がってしまった。
blocks.translation: It feels like a design that rejects the gameplay up to that point, and I can't say it was fun. This one section alone lowered my opinion of the game by a whole level.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: まず気になるのはロード時間。
blocks.translation: The first thing that stands out is the loading time.

blocks.source: ゲーム開始時、全滅ロード時、章が進行した時などに一分程度のロードを行う。
blocks.translation: There is about a minute of loading when starting the game, loading after a party wipe, when progressing to a new chapter, and so on.

blocks.source: その代わり、シームレスなので戦闘時のロードはない。町やダンジョンとフィールドもそのまま繋がっているため、入る時でもロードがないのはスムーズでありがたい。
blocks.translation: In exchange, the game is seamless, so there is no loading during battles. Towns and dungeons connect directly to the fields, so not having to wait when entering them is smooth and appreciated.

blocks.source: また、車での移動が多いゲームだけれど、その時間がけっこう長い。大した操作はできないので、基本的には放置。一分以上放置はザラ。一度行った場所はスキップ可能だが、これもそれなりにロード時間がかかる。
blocks.translation: Also, although this game involves a lot of travel by car, those trips are fairly long. Since there isn't much you can do, you essentially just leave it running. Leaving it unattended for over a minute is common. Places you have already visited can be skipped, but this also takes a fair amount of loading time.

blocks.source: サブクエストを行う場合、上記の理由から、ロードや車の運転時間が頻繁に入ってくる。操作できない時間がたくさんあるので、気が短い人には辛いかも。
blocks.translation: When doing side quests, the reasons mentioned above mean that loading and driving sequences occur frequently. There is a lot of time when you can't control anything, so it may be tough for impatient people.

blocks.source: もう一つ気になったのは、文字が小さくて見にくいこと。
blocks.translation: Another thing that bothered me was how small and difficult-to-read the text is.

blocks.source: とても目が疲れる。セリフについては、ボイスを聞けばだいたい分かるが、様々な表示が小さいので困る。背景が白いと溶け込むことも。
blocks.translation: It makes my eyes very tired. You can generally understand the dialogue by listening to the voices, but the various displays are so small that they're troublesome. They can also blend into the background when it is white.

blocks.source: 例えば、敵のレベル表示が小さくて見極めづらい。Lv25かと思いきやLV35だったりで、戦ってよいかどうかの判断が難しい。
blocks.translation: For example, the enemy level display is so small that it is difficult to make out. You may think it's Lv25 only to find that it's LV35, making it difficult to decide whether you should fight.

blocks.source: １．５ｍもＴＶ画面から離れれば、視力１．５でも不自由する。ワイヤレスコントローラーでの寝転がりプレイがやり辛かった。
blocks.translation: Even with 1.5 vision, sitting 1.5 m away from the TV screen makes things difficult to see. Playing while lying down with a wireless controller was uncomfortable.

blocks.source: 他に気になったことをまとめると……。
blocks.translation: To sum up the other things that bothered me...

blocks.source: 地図も表示が小さくて見づらい。特に高低差があるマップだと、どこが移動できてどこができないのかが分からない。
blocks.translation: The map display is also small and difficult to read. Especially on maps with elevation differences, it's hard to tell where you can and cannot move.

blocks.source: 所々に見えない壁がある嫌らしいマップ。低いフェンスを飛び越えられず、回り道をさせられることも。
blocks.translation: The unpleasant maps have invisible walls scattered throughout. Sometimes you can't jump over low fences and are forced to take a detour.

blocks.source: ○ボタンに操作を集約しすぎで、誤操作が頻発した。道具を拾う、武器を振る、ダッシュなど。
blocks.translation: Too many controls are assigned to the ○ button, resulting in frequent accidental inputs, such as picking up items, swinging weapons, and dashing.

blocks.source: 町やダンジョンなど場所によっては移動速度が低下する。いちいち○ボタンでダッシュするのが面倒。
blocks.translation: Movement speed decreases in certain areas, such as towns and dungeons. Having to press the ○ button to dash every time is a hassle.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: このシリーズらしくグラフィクは一級。
blocks.translation: As you'd expect from this series, the graphics are top-notch.

blocks.source: マップの隅々から料理までが作り込まれたグラフィック。車での移動中に風景を眺めているだけでも、わりと退屈しない。
blocks.translation: The graphics are painstakingly detailed, from every corner of the maps to the food. Even just looking at the scenery while traveling by car is fairly entertaining.

blocks.source: 正直、ここまで長い開発時間をかけて作り込む必要があったのか――というツッコミは置いておいて。
blocks.translation: Setting aside the question of whether it really needed such an extremely long development period to achieve this level of detail—

blocks.source: 欠点を言えば、戦闘が乱戦気味で見た目にも美しくないこと。
blocks.translation: If I had to name a flaw, it would be that the battles tend to become chaotic and aren't visually appealing.

blocks.source: ダンジョンでは暗い画面が多いこと。ホラーゲームのような暗いダンジョンがいくつもあって、特に十三章は演出がもろにホラー。正直、辛かった。
blocks.translation: Many of the dungeons have dark screens. There are several dungeons as dark as those in horror games, and Chapter 13 in particular is presented as outright horror. Honestly, it was tough.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: ＦＦ１０や１３のように強烈な印象を残すことはないけれど、地味に良曲あり。
blocks.translation: It doesn't leave as strong an impression as FF10 or FF13, but there are some understated gems.

blocks.source: メインテーマ的に使われているフィールド曲や、後半通常戦闘曲が特にお気に入り。
blocks.translation: I especially like the field music used almost as a main theme, as well as the regular battle music in the latter half.

blocks.source: もっとも、フィールドや戦闘の曲は何らかの基準でコロコロ変わる。後半は怖い戦闘曲が流れまくるのでちょっと嫌。
blocks.translation: That said, the field and battle music changes constantly according to some kind of criterion. The latter half plays frightening battle music all the time, which I found a bit unpleasant.

blocks.source: 総評
blocks.translation: Overall Assessment

blocks.source: 色々と不満はあっても、前半部は十分に良ゲーだった。オープンワールド好きなら何十時間と楽しめるはず。
blocks.translation: Despite my various complaints, the first half was more than good enough. If you like open-world games, you should be able to enjoy dozens of hours.

blocks.source: しかし、後半はその好印象を一転させてしまう急転振り。
blocks.translation: However, the latter half abruptly reverses that positive impression.

blocks.source: 『本編なんておまけ、メインディッシュはサブクエスト』という考え方もあるけれど、おまけと見なすにも本編後半が重苦しすぎて……。
blocks.translation: Some people take the view that “the main story is just a bonus, and the side quests are the main course,” but even if you regard it as a bonus, the latter half of the main story is far too oppressive...

blocks.source: 単体のストーリーとしては、終盤の重苦しい展開も一つの味と見なすこともできる。説明不足とはいえ、個人的にはそこまで悪いシナリオだとも思わない。
blocks.translation: As a standalone story, the grim developments near the end can also be viewed as part of its character. Although the explanations are insufficient, I personally don't think the scenario is that bad.

blocks.source: けれど、オープンワールドとしての楽しさを殺してしまっているのも事実。どうにもゲームデザインが一貫していない印象を受けてしまった。
blocks.translation: Still, it is also true that the game kills the fun of being an open world. I couldn't shake the impression that the game design lacks consistency.

texts.ＦＦ１３と同じで、進行度によって物語の印象がガラリと変わる。: As with Final Fantasy XIII, the impression of the story changes dramatically depending on your progress.
texts.前半は数人で帝国の基地に殴り込んだり、お使いイベントをこなしたり、十三の武器を探: In the first half, the game progresses at a relaxed pace as you storm Imperial bases with a few companions, complete errands, and search for the thirteen weapons.
texts.始めて行く場所などでは、仲間達が色々と掛け合いをしてくれる。他愛ない内容も多いけ: When you visit places for the first time, your companions exchange all kinds of banter. Much of it is trivial, but it makes the adventure feel even more genuine.
texts.どちらかと言えば、サブクエスト重視のゲーム。メインストーリーそっちのけで、旅をす: This is, if anything, a side quest-focused game. It is fun to travel around while neglecting the main story.
texts.そこまでのオープンワールド的な雰囲気はよくできていて、ここまでは神ゲーっぽく見え: The open-world atmosphere up to that point is well done, and until then, it is not hard to see the game as something exceptional. I myself thought, “An epic story is about to unfold!”
texts.……が、途中から一気に話が収束に向かっていく。ストーリーも急に一本道へ。: ...But partway through, the story suddenly rushes toward its conclusion. It abruptly becomes completely linear as well.
texts.これからヒロインが大活躍かと思ったら、そんなことはなかった。: I thought the heroine would play a major role from that point on, but that did not happen.
texts.帝国の幹部と熾烈な戦いを繰り広げるのかと思ったら、そんなことはなかった。: I thought we would have fierce battles with Imperial officials, but that did not happen.
texts.一時加入したサブキャラが、後半にまた活躍したりはしなかった。: The supporting character who temporarily joined the party did not become active again in the latter half.
texts.十三の武器は別に集めなくてもよかった（サブイベントで回収可）。: There was no particular need to collect the thirteen weapons (they can be recovered through side events).
texts.じゃあ、何のために最初集めさせたの？: Then why did the game make us collect them in the first place?
texts.そもそも、本筋に深く関わる人物が全体で十人もいないような……。: To begin with, there do not seem to be even ten characters in the entire game who are deeply involved in the main plot...
texts.というように、ＦＦ１３を彷彿とさせるような尻すぼみ。: As you can see, it peters out in a way reminiscent of Final Fantasy XIII.
texts.しかも、後半はストーリー的にもゲーム的にもプレイヤーのメンタルにダメージを与える: What is more, the latter half continues with developments that damage the player's mental state, both story-wise and gameplay-wise. I cannot help but admire, for better or worse, how they managed to do something like this in a major Final Fantasy title.
texts.今作の特徴として、アクション型の戦闘が挙げられる。: One of this game's defining features is its action-based battles.
texts.ＦＦ１２のように見た目がアクションっぽいというだけではなく、れっきとしたアクショ: Unlike Final Fantasy XII, where the battles merely looked somewhat like action games, these are genuine action battles.
texts.○ボタンを押しておけば自動的に近くの敵に攻撃してくれるので、そこは簡単。: Simply hold down the ○ button and you will automatically attack a nearby enemy, so that part is easy.
texts.回避や防御もしっかりと効果がある。プレイスキルの差はそれなりに出るはず。: Dodging and guarding are also properly effective. Differences in player skill should be noticeable to some extent.
texts.特徴的なのは、主人公ノクティスの特殊能力シフトブレイク。武器を投げた場所へ瞬時に: The protagonist Noctis's distinctive special ability is Shift Break. It lets him instantly move to the location where he throws his weapon. Being able to launch an attack at a distant enemy all at once feels quite satisfying.
texts.今回の魔法は個数消費となった代わりに、威力も強力となった。強力な魔法を手にして、: In this game, magic is consumed by quantity instead, but its power has also been increased. You have the freedom to acquire powerful magic and challenge formidable enemies in side quests.
texts.ただし、不満点もそれなりに。: However, it has its fair share of frustrating points.
texts.まず、アクション戦闘特有の『何をやってるのか分からない感』があること。: First, there is the feeling, peculiar to action battles, of “not knowing what you are doing.”
texts.数が多い雑魚戦や、動きの派手なボス戦では、何をやっているのかわけが分からなくなり: In battles against large numbers of weak enemies or bosses with flashy movements, it is easy to lose track of what is happening. If you fight normally, you may find yourself taking damage before you realize it.
texts.加えて、仲間の操作はＡＩ任せで指定できない。敵の大技を回避しようとせず、あっさり: In addition, you cannot control your companions or give them commands; they are left to the AI. It was frustrating to see them casually take powerful enemy attacks without even trying to evade them.
texts.結果、たどり着いたボス戦での戦法は、遠距離からチクチク攻撃。仲間がやられるのは諦: As a result, my strategy for boss battles became to chip away at them from a distance. I gave up on keeping my companions alive and brute-forced my way through by repeatedly using healing items.
texts.なんせこのゲーム、回復アイテムの使用制限はかなりゆるい。金で集めた回復アイテムで: After all, this game places very few restrictions on the use of healing items. If you hang on with healing items bought with money and brute-force your way through, it is surprisingly difficult to suffer a total party wipe. Of course, this ruins the pacing and completely undermines the action elements.
texts.古臭いコマンドバトルのＲＰＧにはありがちな調整だけど、何もそんなものまで持ち込ま: It is the kind of balancing commonly found in old-fashioned RPGs with command battles, but they really did not need to bring that into this game... Ultimately, it left me with the impression that it had combined the worst aspects of command battles with the worst aspects of action battles.
texts.難易度はノーマルでも結構高いので注意。敵の一撃がかなり重いので、適当に突っ込むと: Be warned: the difficulty is quite high even on Normal. Enemy attacks hit extremely hard, so charging in carelessly will quickly deplete your HP.
texts.アクションが苦手な人や、スムーズに進みたい人は、素直にイージーを選んだほうがいい: People who aren't good at action games, or who want to progress smoothly, might be better off simply choosing Easy.
texts.というか、敵が強くなるほど回復アイテム連打によって作業的になってしまう。これなら: In fact, the stronger the enemies become, the more the game turns into a chore of repeatedly using healing items. At this point, I probably should have chosen Easy...
texts.戦闘は置いておくとして、このゲームの魅力はと聞かれれば、オープンワールド的な自由: Putting battles aside, if I had to name this game's appeal, it would be its open-world-like freedom.
texts.序盤から様々なサブクエストをこなしたり、メインストーリーには関係のないダンジョン: There's plenty to do, from completing various side quests early on to exploring dungeons unrelated to the main story.
texts.写真や釣りなどのおまけ要素も充実している。: It also has plenty of bonus features, such as photography and fishing.
texts.ただ上述した通り、後半は一本道になってしまう。: However, as mentioned above, the latter half becomes completely linear.
texts.※一応、『神秘の力で過去に戻る』的なシステムで、オープンワールドのマップに戻るこ: ※Technically, a system akin to “returning to the past through mystical power” allows you to return to the open-world map.
texts.そして、この一本道が何とも窮屈。: And this linearity is extremely restrictive.
texts.特に問題となるのが十三章のダンジョン。『長い』『暗い』『不自由』の三重苦。: The biggest problem is the dungeon in Chapter 13: a threefold ordeal of being “long,” “dark,” and “restrictive.”
texts.細い道を長々と進ませるような作りで、ストーリー的にも陰鬱。道中では数時間に渡って: It's designed to make you travel along narrow paths for a long time, and the story is gloomy as well. For several hours along the way, you have to press onward alone as the protagonist. On top of that, some actions are unavailable due to ability restrictions until partway through.
texts.それまでのゲーム性を否定するような作りで、楽しいとは言えなかった。これ一つで自分: It feels like a design that rejects the gameplay up to that point, and I can't say it was fun. This one section alone lowered my opinion of the game by a whole level.
texts.まず気になるのはロード時間。: The first thing that stands out is the loading time.
texts.ゲーム開始時、全滅ロード時、章が進行した時などに一分程度のロードを行う。: There is about a minute of loading when starting the game, loading after a party wipe, when progressing to a new chapter, and so on.
texts.その代わり、シームレスなので戦闘時のロードはない。町やダンジョンとフィールドもそ: In exchange, the game is seamless, so there is no loading during battles. Towns and dungeons connect directly to the fields, so not having to wait when entering them is smooth and appreciated.
texts.また、車での移動が多いゲームだけれど、その時間がけっこう長い。大した操作はできな: Also, although this game involves a lot of travel by car, those trips are fairly long. Since there isn't much you can do, you essentially just leave it running. Leaving it unattended for over a minute is common. Places you have already visited can be skipped, but this also takes a fair amount of loading time.
texts.サブクエストを行う場合、上記の理由から、ロードや車の運転時間が頻繁に入ってくる。: When doing side quests, the reasons mentioned above mean that loading and driving sequences occur frequently. There is a lot of time when you can't control anything, so it may be tough for impatient people.
texts.もう一つ気になったのは、文字が小さくて見にくいこと。: Another thing that bothered me was how small and difficult-to-read the text is.
texts.とても目が疲れる。セリフについては、ボイスを聞けばだいたい分かるが、様々な表示が: It makes my eyes very tired. You can generally understand the dialogue by listening to the voices, but the various displays are so small that they're troublesome. They can also blend into the background when it is white.
texts.例えば、敵のレベル表示が小さくて見極めづらい。Lv25かと思いきやLV35だった: For example, the enemy level display is so small that it is difficult to make out. You may think it's Lv25 only to find that it's LV35, making it difficult to decide whether you should fight.
texts.１．５ｍもＴＶ画面から離れれば、視力１．５でも不自由する。ワイヤレスコントローラ: Even with 1.5 vision, sitting 1.5 m away from the TV screen makes things difficult to see. Playing while lying down with a wireless controller was uncomfortable.
texts.他に気になったことをまとめると……。: To sum up the other things that bothered me...
texts.地図も表示が小さくて見づらい。特に高低差があるマップだと、どこが移動できてどこが: The map display is also small and difficult to read. Especially on maps with elevation differences, it's hard to tell where you can and cannot move.
texts.所々に見えない壁がある嫌らしいマップ。低いフェンスを飛び越えられず、回り道をさせ: The unpleasant maps have invisible walls scattered throughout. Sometimes you can't jump over low fences and are forced to take a detour.
texts.○ボタンに操作を集約しすぎで、誤操作が頻発した。道具を拾う、武器を振る、ダッシュ: Too many controls are assigned to the ○ button, resulting in frequent accidental inputs, such as picking up items, swinging weapons, and dashing.
texts.町やダンジョンなど場所によっては移動速度が低下する。いちいち○ボタンでダッシュす: Movement speed decreases in certain areas, such as towns and dungeons. Having to press the ○ button to dash every time is a hassle.
texts.このシリーズらしくグラフィクは一級。: As you'd expect from this series, the graphics are top-notch.
texts.マップの隅々から料理までが作り込まれたグラフィック。車での移動中に風景を眺めてい: The graphics are painstakingly detailed, from every corner of the maps to the food. Even just looking at the scenery while traveling by car is fairly entertaining.
texts.正直、ここまで長い開発時間をかけて作り込む必要があったのか――というツッコミは置: Setting aside the question of whether it really needed such an extremely long development period to achieve this level of detail—
texts.欠点を言えば、戦闘が乱戦気味で見た目にも美しくないこと。: If I had to name a flaw, it would be that the battles tend to become chaotic and aren't visually appealing.
texts.ダンジョンでは暗い画面が多いこと。ホラーゲームのような暗いダンジョンがいくつもあ: Many of the dungeons have dark screens. There are several dungeons as dark as those in horror games, and Chapter 13 in particular is presented as outright horror. Honestly, it was tough.
texts.ＦＦ１０や１３のように強烈な印象を残すことはないけれど、地味に良曲あり。: It doesn't leave as strong an impression as FF10 or FF13, but there are some understated gems.
texts.メインテーマ的に使われているフィールド曲や、後半通常戦闘曲が特にお気に入り。: I especially like the field music used almost as a main theme, as well as the regular battle music in the latter half.
texts.もっとも、フィールドや戦闘の曲は何らかの基準でコロコロ変わる。後半は怖い戦闘曲が: That said, the field and battle music changes constantly according to some kind of criterion. The latter half plays frightening battle music all the time, which I found a bit unpleasant.
texts.色々と不満はあっても、前半部は十分に良ゲーだった。オープンワールド好きなら何十時: Despite my various complaints, the first half was more than good enough. If you like open-world games, you should be able to enjoy dozens of hours.
texts.しかし、後半はその好印象を一転させてしまう急転振り。: However, the latter half abruptly reverses that positive impression.
texts.『本編なんておまけ、メインディッシュはサブクエスト』という考え方もあるけれど、お: Some people take the view that “the main story is just a bonus, and the side quests are the main course,” but even if you regard it as a bonus, the latter half of the main story is far too oppressive...
texts.単体のストーリーとしては、終盤の重苦しい展開も一つの味と見なすこともできる。説明: As a standalone story, the grim developments near the end can also be viewed as part of its character. Although the explanations are insufficient, I personally don't think the scenario is that bad.
texts.けれど、オープンワールドとしての楽しさを殺してしまっているのも事実。どうにもゲー: Still, it is also true that the game kills the fun of being an open world. I couldn't shake the impression that the game design lacks consistency.
